paraphrase: One universally accessible two-world, two-individual model has a Boolean-generated fragment admitting a non-world-invariant property but excluding both the selected-world property and selected-individual property. Filtered necessary existence holds for one bearer at the first world and fails for the other at the second; original unrestricted Scott necessary existence fails even for the former. This is a finite formal countermodel, not a judgment that its primitive vocabulary represents real essences or metaphysical possibility.
